**Shandong Binzhou Huike Cyclodextrin Technology Co., Ltd.** is a prominent high-tech enterprise strategically located within the Boxing Economic Development Zone in Binzhou City, Shandong Province, China. Positioned at the heart of the Yellow River Delta, the company has established itself as a leading force in the specialized field of cyclodextrin research, development, production, and global distribution. Since its inception, Huike has dedicated itself to bridging the gap between advanced chemical science and industrial application, providing high-quality solutions for a diverse range of sectors including pharmaceuticals, food production, cosmetics, and environmental protection.

The company’s core expertise lies in the manufacturing of cyclodextrin derivatives and inclusion complexes. Its flagship products, such as Hydroxypropyl Betadex (Hydroxypropyl-beta-cyclodextrin) and Betadex Sulfobutyl Ether Sodium, are manufactured to meet the most stringent international standards. These products are critical pharmaceutical excipients, widely used to enhance the solubility, stability, and bioavailability of active drug ingredients. By operating state-of-the-art production facilities that adhere strictly to Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Huike ensures that every batch meets the rigorous quality requirements of the global medical and chemical industries.

Beyond its technical capabilities, Shandong Binzhou Huike Cyclodextrin Technology Co., Ltd. prides itself on its robust Research and Development (R&D) infrastructure. The company collaborates with leading domestic universities and scientific institutions to stay at the vanguard of molecular encapsulation technology. This commitment to innovation allows them to offer customized synthesis services, catering to the specific needs of international clients. With a market presence that spans across Southeast Asia, Europe, and North America, the company has earned a reputation for reliability and excellence.

In the competitive landscape of the Boxing Economic Development Zone, Huike stands out by integrating sustainable manufacturing processes with a customer-centric philosophy. As the company continues to expand its production capacity and refine its chemical processes, it remains committed to its mission of driving progress in the cyclodextrin industry, contributing to the economic growth of Binzhou and providing essential value to the global supply chain.
